text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-4372 triggered for service=model-catalog (severity=high). Alert: default_revision mismatch detected for model 'summit-7b' across prod clusters.
pagerduty: PD-4372 auto-notification: primary on-call sasha paged. Escalation policy applied after 2m.
sasha: acked PD-4372 :white_check_mark: looking now. saw spike in errors from customer-facing endpoints.
diana: jumping in — any sign this is a deploy or config drift?
sasha: initial grep shows catalog store returned rev=null for summit-7b on region us-west-2, but expected rev v3. our router fell back to a legacy quantized variant with different tokenizer. errors are tokenizer mismatches in logs.
ben-support: getting reports from enterprise-corp that embeddings endpoint returned garbage tokens, customers seeing truncated replies. Impact: 3 customers degraded, one reported 10% error rate on requests in last 10m.
marco: logs: 
```
2026-03-14T15:02:12Z ERROR request_id=abcd1234 tokenizer_mismatch: expected BPE-v2 got BPE-v1
2026-03-14T15:02:14Z WARN model_catalog: default_rev set to "v2-temp" by promotion job 2245007805
```
sasha: that promotion job id 2245007805 — who ran it? looks like an automated promotion pipeline.
diana: i see pipeline run triggered at 15:01 with tag "auto-promo:low-risk". It set default_revision on catalog without running tokenizer compatibility check. :grimacing:
marco: mitigation options: 1) revert catalog default to v3 (fast) 2) patch routing to force v3 for customer orgs 3) disable auto-promote pipeline (prevents repeats).
sasha: prioritize revert + disable auto-promo for now. can someone run `rd catalog set-default summit-7b --rev v3 --force`? I'll coordinate rollback.
marco: running revert now (manual CLI).
marco: command: `rd catalog set-default summit-7b --rev v3 --reason "rollback PD-4372"`
marco: revert succeeded. catalog now reports default_rev=v3 across us-west-2 and eu-central.
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-4372 note: action 'set-default' recorded in timeline.
sasha: rolling checks — tailing router logs to confirm routing to v3 and tokenizer header BPE-v2.
sasha: quick sanity: asking router healthcheck endpoint and model metadata — all show v3 and tokenizer BPE-v2.
ben-support: customers notified via outbound: "We identified a config promotion that briefly set an incompatible model revision. We've reverted to the previous revision and are monitoring. ETA for full verification 30m."
diana: filed a quick PR to add tokenizer compatibility gate to the auto-promo job, and opened a follow-up ticket INF-9985 to add end-to-end integration test. PR link: https://git.redwood/infer/promo-gate/pull/42
marco: also flagged quantize/profile difference — added smoke test to run sample tokenization against promoted rev before applying.
sasha: handing off to oncall-next for the monitoring window. oncall-next please watch PD for 45m, escalate if errors >1% or new customer reports.
oncall-next: got it — taking over monitoring. ping me if anything else.
sasha: thanks all. marking incident resolved in PD once monitoring stable. closing thread in 1h unless new events. :thumbsup:
